pdf_page_format.title: PDF Page Format
pdf_page_format.description: Paper size for PDF output. Controls page dimensions when converting Markdown to PDF via headless Chromium.

pdf_margin.title: PDF Margin
pdf_margin.description: Margin size for PDF output in CSS units. Applied to all four sides of the page. Examples: '20mm', '1in', '0.5cm'.

html_theme.title: HTML Theme
html_theme.description: Visual theme for HTML, PDF, and PNG image output. 'light' uses a white background with dark text; 'dark' uses a dark background with light text.

default_title.title: Default Document Title
default_title.description: Fallback title used when no explicit title parameter is provided. Appears in PDF metadata, HTML <title>, and XML/JSON root element names.

code_style.title: Code Block Style
code_style.description: Syntax highlighting theme for fenced code blocks in HTML, PDF, and image output.

max_input_bytes.title: Max Input Size (bytes)
max_input_bytes.description: Maximum allowed input size in bytes. Documents exceeding this limit are rejected to prevent timeouts. Default is 1 GB.
